message.content:
I’m afraid I don’t have a live connection to an official Canadian holiday database, so I can’t pull a “real‑time” list for you.  
Below is a quick reference of the federal statutory holidays that fell on a day that would normally give you a long weekend in 2023.  (If a holiday fell on a weekday, the nearest weekend day was usually observed as a statutory holiday in most provinces.)

| Date | Holiday | Long‑Weekend Effect |
|------|---------|---------------------|
| **January 1 2023** (Sunday) | New Year’s Day | Observed Monday 2 → 3‑day weekend (Sat 1–Mon 2) |
| **February 20 2023** (Friday) | Family Day (BC, AB, SK, NB) | 3‑day weekend (Fri 20–Sun 22) |
| **April 7 2023** (Friday) | Good Friday | 3‑day weekend (Fri 7–Sun 9) |
| **May 22 2023** (Monday) | Victoria Day | 3‑day weekend (Sat 20–Mon 22) |
| **July 1 2023** (Saturday) | Canada Day | Observed Monday 3 → 3‑day weekend (Sat 1–Mon 3) |
| **September 4 2023** (Monday) | Labour Day | 3‑day weekend (Sat 2–Mon 4) |
| **October 9 2023** (Monday) | Thanksgiving | 3‑day weekend (Sat 7–Mon 9) |
| **November 11 2023** (Friday) | Remembrance Day | 3‑day weekend (Fri 11–Sun 13) |
| **December 25 2023** (Monday) | Christmas | 3‑day weekend (Sat 23–Mon 25) |

> **Note:**  
> • Some provinces observe additional holidays (e.g., Boxing Day, St. Patrick’s Day, etc.) that may also create a long weekend.  
> • If a holiday falls on a weekend, the following weekday is usually observed as a statutory holiday, which can also give you a long weekend.

If you need the definitive list for your app, you could pull it from the Government of Canada’s “Public Holidays” API or from the provincial government sites. Let me know if you’d like help formatting that data for your app!
